summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the superstitious custom known as the Kepse, which involves an exchange of hairpins between a bride-to-be and a guest who has recently married or given birth. He explains the mechanics of the ceremony, the role of metal and nighttime in warding off evil spirits, and how the practice serves to address the bride's psychological concerns regarding potential ill-will.
subjects: Role of metal in warding off evil
questions: Who participates in the exchange of hairpins?
